component.title: Catalog Relationships Panel
component.purpose: Expose dependency closure, reverse dependents, rung bands, blast radius, and host obligations for an asset.

states.description: The graph is available while host obligations are unavailable.
The relationship service failed and explains the failure.
Relationships and host obligations are readable.

claims.statement: The panel exposes named depends-on and used-by regions.
Every related asset is marked with its numeric rung and the closure is presented in rung order.
Every related asset row is reachable as a keyboard link to that asset's relationships tab.
